layman_headline: SOL is knocking on its profit target — stay patient and let the trade play out.
layman_explanation: The crypto market just had its best week in three years, with Bitcoin up 22% and altcoins surging even more. Our Solana position is up nearly 10% and closing in on the $100 exit target. XRP is slightly underwater after a massive 49% weekly rally — it entered at an aggressive price but still has room to recover. The whole market is in 'Greed' territory, which means opportunities are harder to find without chasing overextended moves.
layman_action: Hold both current positions. SOL is close to its $100 target — consider taking profits if it gets there in the next few days. Watch XRP carefully; the stop-loss at $1.30 protects downside. Don't chase new entries right now — everything has already rallied hard.
expert_reasoning: Every swing candidate in this cycle is problematic for a new entry. PUMP has an RSI of 86 — deeply overbought with a -6% daily pullback already underway. LIT, MON, and XRP have all run 44-49% in 7 days with no RSI or MACD data to confirm a pullback entry. The remaining candidates are stablecoins with no trade potential. BTC dominance at 59.3% signals capital is still concentrated in Bitcoin rather than flowing freely into alts, making alt entries riskier. Fear & Greed at 73 and rising suggests we're entering the phase where chasing becomes dangerous. The best play is to manage existing positions: SOL at $95.70 is 4.5% from the $100 target, and XRP needs consolidation after its massive weekly move. Patience here is the highest-EV strategy.

BTC dominance at 59.3% means alts could underperform if Bitcoin stalls or reverses
XRP's 49% weekly rally may trigger profit-taking that pushes it toward the $1.30 stop-loss
watch_list: SOL price action near $100 — be ready to take profits at exit target
XRP consolidation pattern — watch for a bounce off $1.45 support or breakdown below $1.40
Bitcoin ETF flow data this week — sustained inflows support the broader rally, outflows signal reversal risk

context_banner: Broad market rally is maturing — manage winners, protect capital, and wait for pullback entries rather than chasing extended moves.
